_comment: JSCDSEND1104 (Samu 69478): the shared SCRIPT-RUN contract of the two mail gates: outgoing-copy-gate.py :: script_run_sends (the main agent's approval gate) and email-send-gate.mjs :: scriptRunSends (the sub-agents' send gate). The conformance test (script-run-conformance.test.ts) writes `files` into a fresh directory, runs EVERY case from that directory through BOTH implementations and asserts both equal `expected`, so a divergence between the two copies is a test failure. The JS twin did not follow a `cd` before the run and did not call a missing script a send; both are pinned here. Script contents are fixtures, nothing is executed. Samu 69538: the fail-closed branches (an undecidable cd, -m or path, a missing script) are a send only when the run is addressed (--to/--cc/--bcc or an e-mail address in the command); a readable sender is a send without one.
